• **Data Quality Check**: Review data completeness, accuracy, and consistency, ensuring no missing or duplicate values, and outliers are addressed.
• **Variable Selection**: Assess the relevance and appropriateness of selected features for frequency prediction, including claim counts, claim amounts, policyholder demographics, and risk factors.
• **Handling Categorical Variables**: Verify correct encoding and handling of categorical variables, such as policy types and claim causes.
• **Data Normalization/Scaling**: Check if data is normalized or scaled to prevent feature dominance and ensure model stability.
• **Handling Time-Series Data**: Ensure correct handling of time-series data, including date and time variables, for accurate temporal analysis.
